calls.title: Jeremy Dorn and Ismael Stahelin
calls.summary: Ismael Stahelin is a full-stack developer with 20 years of experience, primarily favoring front-end development with a strong expertise in languages like PHP, Java, and JavaScript. He led a hardware-software integration project for R Touch, enhancing user interaction for Marriott hotels through innovative algorithms. Ismael values roles that have meaningful user impact and promote collaboration, expressing a preference for React and TypeScript in his development projects. He integrates multiple AI coding tools to enhance his workflow and ensures high-quality code without over-engineering. The company’s focus on experimentation, an open-source approach, and client SQL optimization were also discussed. Ismael is currently seeking a full-time role with a monthly compensation around $7,000, open to both contractor and employee statuses.
calls.keywords: Full-stack development, React, Feature Flagging, A/B Testing, Open Source, Data Warehousing
